{{Quote|Activation protocol begins. So, after the long silence, finally someone comes. I am Garon Jard. Millennia ago, I stood as a founder of the Jedi Order.|Garon Jard's hologram|audio=Jard-Intro-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="PoaJ" />}}
'''Garon Jard''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a founding member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. A powerful [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], Ward and fellow Master [[Rajivari]] would invite peers to [[Standard week|week]]-long convocations on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and was part of the informal councils that predated the more structured [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Councils]]. Jard pushed for seeking peace without violence to be a core trait of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and recorded a [[Master Garon's Hologram|teaching hologram]] that was stored on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].

Twenty thousand [[Standard year|years]] after Jard's [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] was rediscovered by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] region but came under [[Flesh Raider uprising|threat]] from [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Flesh Raider]]s. Around [[3643 BBY]], the [[The Barsen'thor|new Padawan]] of [[Jedi archaeologist]] [[Yuon Par]] was sent to save the hologram and conversed with it before recovering it from its [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] and taking it to Par at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Tython.

==Biography==
===Founding Jedi===
{{Quote|When the Jedi Order began, I saw we must be dedicated to peace. To calming our emotions, and ending war across the galaxy. If we fought, it should only be in self-defence. That is the founding principle of civilization.|Garon Jard's hologram|audio=Jard-Peace-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="PoaJ" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Garon Jard was one of the founders of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="PoaJ" /> and came to serve as a powerful [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], sitting together in council with other Jedi on the order's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], to share new discoveries and explore the true nature of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Alongisde fellow Jedi Master [[Rajivari]], Jard would invite their peers to [[Standard week/Legends|week]]-long convocations with the aim of increasing the Order's wisdom and strengtheing the Jedi's defenses against the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side of the Force]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

These informal and fluid councils also took on the responsibility of recruiting new [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] and ensuring their proper [[Jedi training/Legends|training]], acting as the basis of the later, more structured [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Councils]], including the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. The High Council formed within Ward's lifetime, and the Jedi Master was quoted as saying that each of the twelve members of the High Council arrived there at the right time and place all according to the will of the Force.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Jard pushed for the early Jedi to be dedicated to peace and ultimately recorded a [[Master Jard's Hologram|teaching hologram]] stored in a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] for future generations to use.<ref name="PoaJ" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|The Jedi may have changed, but galactic peace has always remained one of our goals. Activation protocol complete. Go well.|Garon Jard's hologram|audio=Jard-Complete-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="PoaJ" />}}
[[File:GaronJardHologram-SWTOR.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=A blue hologram of Garon Jard is projected above a holoprojector with the forest of the Tythonian Gnarls visible in the background.|Garon Jard recorded a teaching hologram.]]
The holocron was stored in a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] on a [[Stone/Legends|stone]] bridge in the northwest area of the area of Tython known as the [[Tythonian Gnarls]], but was eventually lost to the Jedi. After the Jedi returned to Tython following the [[Sacking of Coruscant|destruction]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="PoaJ" /> twenty thousand [[Standard year|years]] later<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> in [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> Jedi researchers eventually uncovered Jard's hologram along with several other teaching holograms in the Gnarls region.<ref name="PoaJ" />

However, before they could be fully studied, Tython's native [[Flesh Raider]]s began attacking the [[Gnarls Outpost|Jedi training grounds]] in the Gnarls region, putting the holoprojector housing Jard's holocron at risk.<ref name="PoaJ" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the [[Jedi archaeologist]] [[Yuon Par]] dispatched her [[The Barsen'thor|new Padawan]] from the nearby [[Masters' Retreat]] to save the teaching holograms as the first task in<ref name="PoaJ" /> his<ref name="FOD">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]].<ref name="PoaJ" />

The Padawan discovered the northwest holoprojector in the Gnarls and examined it, beginning activation protocols for Jard's hologram, which acknowledged how long it had been silent and shared some of the Jedi Master's wisdom with the Padawan through discussion before completing its activation protocol and deactivating. The Padawan then brought Jard's hologram and the other teaching holograms back to Par at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Tython.<ref name="PoaJ" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|To protect without fighting. A trait I wanted at the core of our beliefs.|Garon Jard's hologram|audio=Jard-Protect-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="PoaJ" />}}
Jard wanted one of the core traits of the Jedi to be protecting others without fighting, seeing that the the order must be dedicated to peace and ending war across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Wanting Jedi to calm their emotions, Jard believed that they should only fight in self-defense or defense of those weaker then themselves, acknowledging the mark that such actions left upon history and the Jedi themselves. The Jedi Master saw these ideas as the founding principles of civilization, seeing developments made during war time like dealier weapons or stronger armies no good for feeding the hungry of healing the sick.<ref name="PoaJ" /> Jard had [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], light skin, and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Colors" />

==Equipment==
The hologram of Garon Jard depicted the Jedi Master as wearing a set of<ref name="PoaJ" /> brown<ref name="Colors" /> [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]].<ref name="PoaJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
A hologram of Garon Jard appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="PoaJ" />
